updatedText.text:
Create a Figma Design file in the team’s practice location. Name it Tebra first rebuild · Your name.

Create a page named First rebuild and copy the file link for Codex.

Optional: if you’d like feedback, post the link in #uxhotline or share it with Daniel Cole.
You can edit your new file and have its link ready for Codex. Sharing it for feedback is optional.

Font access is checked; loading is verified during the build.
The starter is copied once supplied, and its selection link is ready.
